title: SCHC session clocks can create immortal state or leak replay pins
description: SchcSessionManager and _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager accept an injected clock but use its raw result without validating numeric type, finiteness, non-negativity, or monotonic progression. NaN makes every now >= expires_at test false, so prepared senders, active sessions, tombstones, and receiver contexts can become immortal; regression arbitrarily extends hold-down. In activate_and_start(), replay state is pinned before the first clock call, so a raising clock callback exits without a session record and leaks a replay pin permanently. Add one validated monotonic clock wrapper/high-water policy for SCHC timer state, obtain time before irreversible pin/allocation transitions (or roll them back), fail closed on regression/reentry/non-finite results, and cover raise/NaN/infinity/regression at activation and expiry boundaries.
